text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: The "Grayish Club" Fishing Tournament~! Let's all have fun~, yay~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the invitation, Sky-san. Is everyone ready as well, desu wa?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yaaay. Hayahide-chan, do you go fishing often?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No, not often. But so long as one understands the basic dynamics, one can manage somehow.
Guided by fishing enthusiast Seiun Sky, the four Grayish Club members who happened to have free time came to the ocean.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Now then~, shall we take it easy~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I shall definitely reel in a massive catch, desu wa. Upon the pride of the Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm, I don't necessarily demand a massive catch, but—I would like a haul commensurate with the time invested.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: As for me... it doesn't have to be super big, but catching something would be nice~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I don't really mind coming up empty-handed. Fishing is all about enjoying the passage of time, after all~.
choice_data_list: (Their motivation levels are... all over the place!)

text_block_list.text: Even though they belonged to the same Grayish Club, their enthusiasm varied wildly.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Now, now, I think it's better not to get too tense. Because, you know~...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I've got a bad feeling about today...
(Whoosh... whoosh...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Not a single bite! Absolutely none!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah~ this is what you'd call a "dead calm"~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: In other words, no wind and no waves. On such seemingly perfect fishing days, you surprisingly don't catch anything at all~.
choice_data_list: I see, too calm is also bad
Right, being too calm isn't good either

text_block_list.text: If that's the case, today was going to be an uphill battle, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm, looking at it rationally... persisting much longer today won't accomplish anything.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah, true. How about we just try a little bit more and...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Already?! No, please allow me to continue until I am thoroughly satisfied!
Even regarding when to call it quits, despite being from the same club, they weren't in sync at all.
Perhaps today would just end with everyone dispersing separately, but...
An unexpected thing happened. Even the horse girls who insisted "today's a bust" showed no sign of packing up their rods...
Every single one of them displayed phenomenal persistence! And then—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Phew~ glad we caught something. Mine was pretty small, but I guess it's better than nothing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Merely avoiding going home empty-handed is a satisfactory outcome.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I am satisfied with this catch, desu wa. As expected, the result depends entirely upon one's willpower... doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nyahaha♪ I've brought all sorts of folks fishing before, but this might be the first time I've seen such a stubborn bunch gathered together.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What's up, Trainer-san?
All four of today's members are horse girls renowned for their aptitude in long-distance races.
That's why, despite their different personalities, every one of them was able to endure until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I see~. Maybe gray horse girls have a lot of girls who know how to persevere.
